title: NANSEN dev ROIs
description: An ROI file of NANSEN dev (.mat with a struct array roiArray, as dev's roimanager saves it): Mask ROIs are their pixels, Circle ROIs a disk as dev's RoI makes it, and Polygon ROIs the pixels whose centre is inside. Read as the module's ROI document (imageSize and rois of id, area, center and 0-based [row, column] pixels), so the ROIs can be viewed, curated and have their signals extracted. Read only.
